steps.action: Move beyond Approval, second paragraph: at an Approval Status with one Pending and one Rejected approval, a confirmed send from the Signatures tab moves the Contract to a Signature Status without opening Move past approval and records no override
steps.expected: No Move past approval dialog; a new Out for signature row; the Contract is at a Signature Status; approvals keep Pending and Rejected; History has no override entry.
steps.actual: C-40 stood at "Awaiting approval" (approval) with ["Priya Raman:rejected","Tom Iwu:pending"]. Signatures > Send for signature opened the dialog with Version "Version 1 — doc032-contracts-legal_team_member-send.pdf (current)". With one Signer filled, Send envelope was disabled until "Yes, all required signatures will be in place" was chosen under "Will the agreement be fully signed when this DocuSign round is complete?" (a required question electronic-signing.md does not name); Send envelope closed the dialog. Move past approval did not open within 15 s. The tab then showed "pdf Version 1 Out for signature Sep 28 Prepared by Nadia Haddad —". The Contract is now "Out for signature" (signature). Approvals kept ["Priya Raman:rejected","Tom Iwu:pending"]. History shows no override entry; its status line reads "Nadia Haddad changed the status Awaiting approval → Out for signature this minute Nadia Haddad sent this contract for signature this minute Priya Ram".
